# Pagination

Pagination moves between pages of data. Under a DataTable, put it in the `footer` of the table. When changing
pages, keep the old data until the new data arrives so that the content does not flicker.

**Interaction**: the current page has a subtle accent background with accent text and no border; other pages
add the state layer on hover and press; `Tab` focuses the page numbers one by one and shows the focus ring, and
`Enter` goes to the focused page.

**Category**: Data · **Common uses**: Pagination of lists that are not tables, such as card lists and search results

## Import

```ts
import { Pagination } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Lists outside a table are paginated on their own; for a DataTable, put the Pagination in its `footer`.

```tsx
import { Pagination } from 'vellum-ui'

export function Basic() {
  return <Pagination defaultCurrent={2} total={128} pageSize={20} showSizeChanger={false} />
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `total` | `number` | Total number of items. | — | Yes |
| `current` | `number` | Current page, starting at 1 (controlled). | — | No |
| `defaultCurrent` | `number` | Page shown at first (uncontrolled). | `1` | No |
| `pageSize` | `number` | Number of items per page. | `10` | No |
| `onChange` | `(page: number, pageSize: number) => void` | Called with the new page and page size when the page or the page size changes. | — | No |
| `showSizeChanger` | `boolean` | Shows the page size selector. By default it is shown when `total` is more than 50. | — | No |
| `showTotal` | `(total: number) => ReactNode` | Text before the page numbers, built from the total number of items, such as "128 items". | — | No |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | Size: `sm` under tables and in panels. Without it, the size follows the density. | — | No |

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.
